legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment of Contract is assignable by Assignor, and Assignor hereby assigns all of its rights, title, and interest in and to the Original Contract to Assignee.
legal_clauses.indemnification: Assignee shall indemnify and hold harmless Assignor against any and all claims, damages, or expenses arising out of or related to the Original Contract or this Assignment.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any dispute arising out of or related to this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and obligations associated with the purchase of the Property, including but not limited to title insurance, transfer taxes, and recording fees.
